review_title: Tricyclic drugs for depression in children and adolescents
screening_criteria: Randomised controlled trials comparing the efficacy of orally administered tricyclic drugs with placebo in depressed people aged 6 to 18 years.
gold_label_policy_description: dataset label 1.0 counts as INCLUDE; 0.5 and 0.0 count as EXCLUDE

studies.study_title: Pulse intravenous clomipramine for depressed adolescents: double‐blind, controlled trial
studies.predicted_reason: Although this is an RCT comparing clomipramine with placebo in depressed adolescents (mean age 16.2 years), the intervention was administered intravenously (200 mg iv), not orally. The selection criteria explicitly require orally administered tricyclic drugs.

studies.study_title: A double‐blind, randomized, placebo‐controlled trial of fluoxetine in children and adolescents with depression
studies.predicted_reason: This RCT compares fluoxetine (an SSRI, not a tricyclic antidepressant) with placebo. The review is specifically about tricyclic drugs.

studies.study_title: Double‐blind placebo‐controlled study of nortriptyline in depressed adolescents using a "fixed plasma level" design
studies.predicted_reason: This is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of orally administered nortriptyline (a tricyclic antidepressant) in depressed adolescents aged 12-17 years with major depressive disorder. It meets all selection criteria.

studies.study_title: Childhood and adolescent depression: a review of the past 10 years. Part I
studies.predicted_reason: This is a qualitative review article, not a randomized controlled trial. It does not compare a tricyclic drug with placebo.

studies.study_title: Imipramine treatment of depressed children: a double‐blind pilot study
studies.predicted_reason: This is a double-blind pilot study (RCT) comparing oral imipramine (a tricyclic antidepressant) with placebo in depressed children. It meets the population (depressed children), intervention (oral tricyclic), comparison (placebo), and design (RCT) criteria.

studies.study_title: Amitriptyline in children with major depressive disorder: a double‐blind crossover pilot study
studies.predicted_reason: This is a randomized, double-blind crossover trial comparing oral amitriptyline (a tricyclic antidepressant, 1-2.5 mg/kg/day) with placebo in children aged 9-12 years with major depressive disorder. It meets all selection criteria.

studies.study_title: Newer generation antidepressants for depressive disorders in children and adolescents
studies.predicted_reason: This is a Cochrane review focusing on newer generation antidepressants (particularly SSRIs), not tricyclic drugs. It is a systematic review, not a primary RCT.

studies.study_title: Imipramine plus cognitive‐behavioural therapy in the treatment of school refusal
studies.predicted_reason: While this RCT compares imipramine with placebo, the study population was selected based on school refusal (not depression as the primary condition), and the primary outcome was school attendance. Although participants had comorbid major depression, the study is focused on treating school refusal rather than depression per se.

studies.study_title: Imipramine in prepubertal major depressive disorders
studies.predicted_reason: This is a double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT investigating oral imipramine (up to 5 mg/kg/day) in prepubertal children with major depressive disorder. It includes a five-week double-blind placebo-controlled design and meets all selection criteria.

studies.study_title: Efficacy of paroxetine treatment in the treatment of adolescent depression: a randomized, controlled trial
studies.predicted_reason: This is a three-arm RCT (paroxetine, imipramine, placebo) in adolescents with major depression. It includes a direct comparison of oral imipramine (a tricyclic antidepressant) versus placebo in depressed adolescents aged approximately 12-18 years, thereby meeting the review's selection criteria for the tricyclic versus placebo comparison.

studies.study_title: Mechanism of action of antidepressant medications
studies.predicted_reason: This is a review article discussing the pharmacological mechanisms of antidepressants. It is not a randomized controlled trial comparing tricyclic drugs with placebo for depression in children or adolescents.

studies.study_title: SSRI safety in overdose
studies.predicted_reason: This study examines SSRI safety in overdose using case reports and poison control data. It is not an RCT, does not involve tricyclic drugs as the intervention of interest, and does not assess efficacy for depression.

studies.study_title: Measuring inconsistency in meta‐analyses
studies.predicted_reason: This is a methodological paper about meta-analysis statistics. It is not a primary randomized controlled trial of tricyclic drugs for depression in children or adolescents.

studies.study_title: Clinical, electrocardiographic, and laboratory findings in children with amitriptyline intoxication
studies.predicted_reason: This is a case series/review of children with amitriptyline poisoning. It is not an RCT and does not assess the efficacy of tricyclic drugs for depression.

studies.study_title: The effect of concomitant disorders in childhood depression on predicting treatment response
studies.predicted_reason: This appears to be a secondary analysis examining how comorbid disorders predict treatment response, rather than a primary report of an RCT comparing tricyclic drugs with placebo. The abstract does not establish that this is the primary trial report meeting all selection criteria.

studies.study_title: Adolescent depression: controlled desipramine treatment and atypical features
studies.predicted_reason: This is a randomized, placebo-controlled trial of oral desipramine (a tricyclic antidepressant) versus placebo in adolescents aged 13-18 years with major depressive disorder. It meets all selection criteria.

studies.study_title: Psychopharmacology of child and adolescent major depression: present status and future directions
studies.predicted_reason: This is a narrative review and opinion paper about the state of psychopharmacology research. It is not a randomized controlled trial comparing tricyclic drugs with placebo.

studies.study_title: Comparative studies of pharmacotherapy for school refusal
studies.predicted_reason: This RCT compares alprazolam and imipramine with placebo for school refusal, not for depression as the primary condition. The population is defined by school refusal rather than by depression, and the primary focus is on anxiety and school attendance outcomes rather than depression.

studies.study_title: Selected tricyclic antidepressant ingestions involving children 6 years old or less
studies.predicted_reason: This is a case series/review of poison control data on accidental tricyclic antidepressant ingestions in young children. It is not an RCT and does not assess efficacy for depression.

studies.study_title: A randomized, controlled trial of amitriptyline in the acute treatment of adolescent major depression
studies.predicted_reason: This is a randomized, double-blind, parallel-design, placebo-controlled trial of oral amitriptyline (5 mg/kg/day) in adolescents aged 12-17 years with major depressive disorder. It meets all selection criteria.

studies.study_title: School phobia: a therapeutic trial with clomipramine and short‐term outcome
studies.predicted_reason: This double-blind trial investigates clomipramine for school phobia/school refusal, not for depression as the primary condition. Although depression symptoms are mentioned, the study population is defined by school phobia/neurotic disorder, not by depression.

studies.study_title: Meta‐analysis of early phase II studies with paroxetine in hospitalised depressed patients
studies.predicted_reason: This is a meta-analysis of phase II studies comparing paroxetine with amitriptyline in hospitalized depressed adults aged 18-65 years. It is not a primary RCT, the population is adults, and it does not include a placebo comparison relevant to the review criteria.

studies.study_title: Depression in children: relationship between plasma imipramine levels and response
studies.predicted_reason: This study examined plasma imipramine levels and response in 20 prepubertal children with major depression. However, there is no mention of randomization or a placebo control group; all children appear to have received imipramine after a psychotherapy run-in. It does not meet the RCT or placebo comparison criteria.

studies.study_title: Randomized, controlled trial of amitriptyline versus placebo for adolescents with "treatment‐resistant" major depression
studies.predicted_reason: This is a 10-week randomized, controlled trial comparing oral amitriptyline (a tricyclic antidepressant) with placebo in adolescents with major depressive disorder. It meets all selection criteria.

studies.study_title: Imipramine compliance in adolescents
studies.predicted_reason: This is a secondary analysis of a double-blind RCT focusing on medication compliance, side effects, and guessing of drug assignment. It is not the primary efficacy report of the underlying trial, and the underlying trial population (anxious-depressed adolescents with school refusal) was selected for school refusal rather than depression as the primary condition.
